verdict.rationale: Canny's MCP page says users can 'reply to customers' while moving ideas through the workflow, and the changelog lets teams announce shipped work and show customers they were heard. Neither source describes replying directly from inside a feedback record in the Canny app, and the reply claim appears only in the LLM/MCP context. Missing for 10: documented in-app reply or comment-to-customer from the feedback post, details on how customers are notified of replies or status changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
